kicker.zh: 型号 / 接口 / 材料

intro.en: Define the interfaces, material requirements and acceptance plan for your custom project.
intro.zh: 围绕定制项目定义接口、材料要求与验收方案。

jump.zh: 查看接口配置与材料选型

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.zh: 经原厂资料核验的接口组件参考。

intro.en: Materials identified for the specific interface or molding process.
intro.zh: 用于具体接口或成型工艺选型的材料。

copy.en: State the function, fit, interface or replacement question that the prototype must answer, together with the current drawing revision.
copy.zh: 说明样品需要回答的功能、装配、接口或替代问题，并提供当前图纸版本。

copy.en: Identify fixed mating interfaces, critical dimensions and electrical needs separately from features still under evaluation.
copy.zh: 将固定对插接口、关键尺寸与电气要求，同仍在验证的结构分开记录。

copy.en: List must-use parts and any customer-approved temporary materials, hand-built details or sample-only deviations.
copy.zh: 列出必须使用的物料，以及客户获准的临时材料、手工结构或仅样品适用的偏离。

copy.en: Capture the built BOM, pin map, measured dimensions, photographs and agreed functional checks for the delivered sample.
copy.zh: 记录交付样品的实际BOM、针脚表、实测尺寸、照片与约定功能检查。

copy.en: Convert sample feedback into a controlled drawing or BOM revision, with open points and the next validation step identified.
copy.zh: 将样品反馈转为受控图纸或BOM版本，并列明待确认项与下一步验证。

copy.en: Review production-intent materials, tooling, process differences and the approved release before treating a working prototype as a repeat-production specification.
copy.zh: 把可运行样品视作重复生产规格前，审核量产材料、工装、工艺差异与获批放行依据。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。

service_label.zh: 可制作兼容替代件、自有原厂采购渠道

reason.en: Project and manufacturer references are shown only at their audited counts. Process requirements are defined separately from finished-product ratings.
reason.zh: 项目与原厂编号仅按实际核验数量展示，工艺要求和成品等级分别定义。
